history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration appropriately deal with the cash pool balances of the three closed country-based pooled fund accounts, properly consolidate the old country-based pooled fund accounts and assign the refunds in a timely manner.
history.administration_response: Of the three closed country-based pooled fund accounts referred to in the original recommendation, only the closure of the Colombia account is outstanding. The process is at an advanced stage and is expected to be completed by June 2025 with the final posting of transactions for the pass-through (P1) grants. This has taken longer than previously expected owing to the complex nature of closing P1 grants. A total of 499 P1 grants remain open; these are legacy projects created in Umoja before the introduction of the Grantor Management module.
history.board_assessment: Given that the closure of the Colombia account is outstanding, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
